base.strategy: unchanged V18 Dominant-Book Transport Acceptance Router

hypothesis: V77 proved one adverse entry minute is normal. A genuine hostile auction may instead require two consecutive completed minutes in which both CL discovery and matched MCL transport close progressively farther against V18, the second closes in the adverse half of both ranges, and at least three of four CL/MCL true-range and volume channels expand above their own prior completed 12-minute medians.

invariants.opportunities: Every exact V18 entry, direction, branch, lane, multiscale ownership label, original exit, roll boundary, and natural density remains present.
invariants.baseline: Exactly 12 contiguous completed same-contract CL/MCL one-minute bars strictly before entry; no future bar, outcome, MFE, MAE, or PnL enters the census.
invariants.first_adverse_minute: Observation only; it can never classify, veto, reverse, or exit.
invariants.progression: Two consecutive post-entry bars must leave both CL and MCL closes adverse to entry, and the second must set a strictly larger adverse close displacement in both books.
invariants.result: On the second bar, both closes must lie in the adverse half of their own high-low range.
invariants.effort: At least three of CL true range, MCL true range, CL volume, and MCL volume must strictly exceed their causal 12-bar median.
invariants.possible_action: Count an event at the second close; any future lifecycle could only surrender at the next matched-MCL open before the unchanged V18 exit.

selection_law: Only the primary may advance directly. Sensitivity cells test local semantic continuity but cannot replace a failed primary from these counts. If the primary passes both periods, freeze one lifecycle before exposing discovery PnL; validation remains sealed unless discovery improves unchanged V18 after both cost models without weakening direction, branch, lane, ownership, temporal breadth, concentration, or drawdown.
prohibitions: no entry suppression, delayed entry, inversion, add-on, re-entry, stop, target, quota, or size change
no threshold, lookback, streak, effort-count, close-location, direction, branch, lane, ownership, session, calendar, news, or cost rescue
no PnL, MFE, MAE, original outcome, or validation economics during the census
no order, preview, selection, capital, XSP, Gold, news, or live-authority mutation
